arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: finish with pod reserve near empty at the line. After the hard start, settle to about sustainable shaft power (pod ~195-200 W). Push a little more on legs against the current/wind, a little less with it. Final sprint from ~400 m to go. Watch for incidents: weed on rudder (speed drops with same pod power, push_local falls), pod drift, radio course changes, wind shifts. Do not over-cue; use watches.

arguments.name: drag_resid
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current along heading; drops if drag rises (weed) or pod reads high

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts for 40 s: weed on rudder, drag, or pod drift?
pod reserve below 20 pct with more than 1200 m left

arguments.text: 1.0 min: watches set: drag_jump (drag_resid=push_local-push_along < -0.3 for 40 s: weed/drag/pod drift), pod_reserve_low (<20 pct with >1200 m left), too_hot (shaft >112 pct of sustainable 60 s), too_easy (<90 pct 60 s). Wake at 700 m left for the sprint. Start: shaft 240 W vs CP 192, leg 1 heading north with +0.27 current push.

text: no cue: hard start is expected to settle on its own; plan, watches and sprint wake-up set.

arguments.reason: just after turn 1: leg 2 is against the current (~0.33 m/s); consider a small push cue, target ground pace ~174

arguments.text: 4 min: settled at shaft 194 W (sustainable 198), pod reserve 73 pct steady. Boat-model reserve falls faster (57 pct) than pod: boat power 134 vs CP 122 while shaft is at CP; trust the pod for effort. Current helps leg 1 (north) ~0.33 m/s.

text: no cue: paddler settled at critical power with reserve to spare; wake after the turn to consider pushing into the current.

arguments.text: Into the current now, lift a touch, hold 2:51 pace

arguments.reason: check response to the upstream push cue (want shaft ~205-210 W, not over 220)

text: cued a small push with 2:51 target pace on the upstream leg 2: more power where the boat is slow is faster for the same effort; check in 2 min.

arguments.reason: after turn 2: downstream leg 3, ease slightly to ~185-190 W shaft to bank reserve

arguments.text: 7 min: push cue on upstream leg 2 worked: shaft 194->206 W, GPS pace 2:47. Pod reserve 65 pct. Boat/shaft power ratio in race ~0.67-0.69 vs 0.635 in the test since min 2, so boat-model reserve (38 pct) drains faster than pod; consistent from the start, so not a mid-race pod drift. Trust pod for effort. Current ~0.25-0.3 m/s, helps going north (odd legs).

text: no cue: push into the current is landing at the intended ~206 W; wake after the turn to ease downstream.
no cue: 49 m to the turn, push faded to critical power naturally; pending wake after the turn handles the downstream leg.

arguments.text: Current with you now, ease a touch, settle at 2:28

arguments.reason: check ease response on downstream leg 3 (want shaft ~183-190 W, not below 178)

text: cued a small ease with 2:28 target on downstream leg 3 (paddler 6/10, feels fine; pod reserve 57 pct): spend less where the current carries the boat.

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < 0.85 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and elapsed_s > 240 and remaining_m > 800
arguments.message: shaft power under 85 pct of sustainable for a minute

arguments.reason: after turn 3: upstream leg 4, push cue ~205-210 W shaft (target ground pace ~2:50)

arguments.text: 12.2 min: ease cue on downstream leg 3 took shaft 194->174 W (a bit more than asked), GPS pace 2:27 on target; pod reserve rising 57->60 pct. Water speed only ~1.5 pct lower; push_local and fitted push both fell ~0.08, so the current looks slightly weaker (~0.25-0.3) and the pod looks honest, not drifting. Paddler 6/10 at 10.5 min, feels fine. too_easy watch loosened to 85 pct so downstream easing does not wake me.

text: no cue: easing to 174 W downstream is within a sensible range and the reserve is refilling; push again after the next turn.
no cue: shaft 179 W downstream, on target pace, reserve refilling; already handled in note at 12.2 min.
no cue: paddler reports feeling good and steady, numbers agree; nothing to change before the next turn.

arguments.text: Something on the rudder: one back-stroke to clear it

arguments.reason: check whether clear_rudder fixed the drag: shaft power at the same speed should drop back toward ~195 W

arguments.text: 14.7 min: shaft power ramped 176->234 W over 2.5 min (from ~12.5 min) while GPS speed held ~3.4 and water speed flat; push_local fell 0.31->0.02. Paddler: 5/10, boat feels heavy, like something dragging. Suspect weed on rudder (or added drag); cued clear_rudder at 14.8 min, near turn 3. If speed per watt does not recover after the clear, consider water in hull / other drag, or pod reading high. Pod reserve fell to 39 pct during this.

text: cued clear_rudder: power rose 30 pct with no speed gain and the paddler feels something dragging, so likely weed on the rudder; check result in 75 s.

arguments.reason: plan the final sprint
cue gate opens: shaft 247 W upstream after clear_rudder; decide hold 2:50 (sane target replacing old 2:28) vs pod-drift; check speed per watt

text: no cue: cue gate closed for 16 s and post-turn numbers are still mixed with the back-stroke dip; wake when the gate opens.

arguments.reason: From min 2 to 12 the boat model read boat power ~0.68 of pod shaft power vs 0.635 in the test, so at the pod critical power (192 W) the boat model reads ~130 W, not 122. Rescaling so the boat-model reserve matches the paddler (who reports 5-6/10, fine), because the pod now looks unreliable.

arguments.text: 15.8 min: POD SUSPECT. Pod shaft ramped 176->256 W since 12.8 min with no speed gain (water 3.07, GPS 2:54 upstream vs 2:48 at 200 W on leg 2), yet paddler says 5/10, steady, feels fine (was 6/10 at 195 W). Smooth ramp = drift, not a weed step. clear_rudder at 14.8 was done (dip seen). Ignore pod numbers (shaft power, w_bal_pod, push_local, sustainable_shaft); use boat model + GPS. Removed pod watches; set boat CP 122->130 W (race boat/pod ratio). Leg 2 reference: 2:48 GPS upstream, 3.24 m/s water at true ~200 W.

boat-model power under 85 pct of sustainable for a minute

speed through water at this rate 6 pct below early race for 45 s: drag (weed) or fatigue

arguments.reason: upstream leg 4: check water speed recovered after clear (want ~3.2 m/s); decide push cue with 2:50 target

text: no cue: pod power reads 256 W with no speed gain while the paddler feels 5/10, so the pod is drifting; switched pacing to the boat model (CP 130 W) and boat-based watches.

arguments.text: Boat is running clean again. Lift into the current, 2:44.

8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back; current ~0.25 m/s helps north (odd legs), hurts south (even legs). POD DRIFTING HIGH since ~12.8 min (reads 260 W at true ~200 W): ignore shaft power, w_bal_pod, push_local, sustainable_shaft. Pace on the boat model (CP set to 130 W) and GPS: aim boat power ~140-145 W upstream (GPS ~2:44), ~125-130 W downstream (GPS ~2:27), finish with boat reserve near empty. Final sprint from ~400-500 m to go. Boat watches: boat_hot, boat_easy, boat_reserve_low, fade_drag (weed). Weed cleared by back-stroke at 14.8 min.

text: cued push with 2:44 target upstream: water speed back to 3.2 m/s at boat CP after the clear, boat reserve 66 pct, so there is room to spend into the current; pod confirmed drifting.

arguments.reason: after turn 4: downstream leg 5, ease to boat ~125-130 W (GPS ~2:27); check boat reserve budget

text: no cue: push landing (boat 136 W, GPS 2:45 heading to 2:44), boat reserve 64 pct; wake after the next turn.

arguments.text: 18.9 min: RADIO: wind filling in from the NORTH 8-12 kn. Headwind on north legs (odd: 5, 7) now opposes the ~0.25 current there; tailwind on south legs (6, 8). Fitted push lags, so boat-model power/water speed read HIGH on south legs and LOW on north legs until refit (at 18.9 boat model 150 W, GPS 2:39 on leg 4 vs 2:46 a minute before). Headwind costs more than tailwind gives: spend more effort on whichever legs are slowest over the ground (check legs()).

text: no cue: wind from the north noted (tailwind this leg, headwind next); paddler 6/10 and feels fine; decide effort for the headwind leg after the turn.

arguments.reason: leg 5 north into headwind: read clean GPS speed (leg 3 north was 3.40, leg 4 south 3.06) and decide even effort vs push into the wind

text: no cue: the north wind has changed which leg is slow; the old ease-downstream plan no longer applies, re-read leg 5 speed in a minute before cueing.

arguments.text: Halfway, strong rhythm. Hold this effort into the wind.

8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Since ~19 min a north wind (8-12 kn) roughly cancels the ~0.25 m/s current: north legs now ~3.2 m/s GPS, south ~3.1-3.2, so EVEN effort on all legs from here. POD DRIFTING HIGH since ~12.8 min: ignore shaft power and pod reserve. Boat model (CP 130 W) reads high on south legs and low on north legs (push fit lags the wind), so judge its reserve over a whole north+south pair. Target: boat reserve ~15-20 pct at 700 m to go, then sprint to empty from ~450 m. Paddler 6/10 at 19 min. Watches: boat_hot, boat_easy, boat_reserve_low, fade_drag.

arguments.reason: after turn 5: compare leg 5 vs leg 6 speed, check boat reserve trend over the pair, ask paddler

text: cued hold: wind and current now roughly cancel, so even effort on every leg; plan updated, wake after the next turn.

arguments.text: 25.1 min: leg 5 north into wind held GPS 3.20-3.23 (2:35) at rate 57. Pod has been flat at ~241-249 W for 5 min while effort steady, so its drift seems to have levelled off: usable as a RELATIVE effort gauge (pod ~243 = current steady effort, about CP to CP+4 pct), not absolute. Boat model reads 115-122 W here (low, headwind) and reserve rose 40->55 pct (phantom refill on north legs).

text: no cue: steady 2:35 into the wind at an even effort as planned; turn in 140 m, review after it.

arguments.reason: paddler 5/10 at 26 min with ~2.9 km left: read clean leg 6 GPS speed, then cue a push of about +5 pct power (pace ~1.5 pct faster than current)

arguments.text: 26.1 min: paddler 5/10, steady, feels fine (reports 5-6 all race). Boat reserve over legs 4+5 fell 67->56 pct, so true reserve ~50 pct. With ~15 min left that allows about CP+5 pct; plan a push of ~+5 pct power now and the sprint from ~450 m.

text: no cue yet: paddler has room (5/10); waiting 40 s for a clean leg 6 speed to set a push target.

arguments.text: You look strong. Start building now, hold 2:35.

arguments.reason: after turn 6, leg 7 north into wind: re-cue push ~2:33 (leg 5 was 2:35 at steady effort); ask paddler

text: cued push to 2:35 (about +5 pct power): paddler 5/10 with ~50 pct reserve and 2.8 km left, so start spending it.
no cue: push landed (relative pod +6 pct, GPS 2:36), turn in 220 m; review after it.

arguments.reason: leg 7 clean speed: if GPS >= 3.30 the push is real (~CP+10 pct, too hot for 1.9 km with ~30 pct reserve: cue hold/ease a touch); if ~3.22 the pod rise is drift (cue hold 2:33)

arguments.text: 31.5 min: paddler 6/10, fine. Reserve estimate: boat model 56 pct at 26.1 (pair-balanced) minus leg-6 push (pod relative +7 pct over leg 5 for 5.3 min, ~27 pct) gives TRUE ~29 pct now, i.e. sustainable only ~CP+5 pct for the last 1.9 km incl. sprint. Pod now +11 pct over leg 5 plateau: either more push (too hot) or drift resumed. Check leg 7 GPS vs leg 5 (3.22).

text: no cue: paddler 6/10; deciding hold vs ease in 40 s from a clean leg 7 speed, because the reserve estimate is tighter than the boat model shows.

arguments.text: Good speed. Hold it right here, smooth, 2:32.

arguments.reason: after the last turn, leg 8 south: set a hold pace for the final leg (leg 6 south at +7 pct was ~2:37), keep reserve for the sprint

arguments.text: 32.2 min: leg 7 north GPS 3.32 vs 3.22 on leg 5 at steady effort: push is real, about CP+10 pct. With ~25-30 pct true reserve and 1.8 km left that is at the edge; cued hold 2:32 (a touch easier). Final leg 8 is south: current against + tailwind. Sprint from ~350-400 m.

text: cued hold at 2:32: the push is real and near the edge of the remaining reserve, so hold rather than build; wake after the last turn.
no cue: holding 2:32 as asked, boat reserve 29 pct; last turn in 190 m, set the final-leg pace after it.

arguments.text: Last leg. Hold 2:36 now, sprint comes at three hundred.

text: cued hold 2:36 for the last leg (replaces the 2:32 north target, which would be too hard into the current) and set the sprint wake at 330 m.

arguments.reason: final sprint cue (finish); boat reserve ~28 pct at 700 m, holding ~CP+8 pct leaves ~1.9-2.2 kJ for the last ~250 m

text: no cue: paddler 8/10 hard but holding 2:37 with ~28 pct reserve; hold to ~270 m, then cue the sprint so it does not empty before the line.

arguments.text: Go now! Empty the tank, all the way to the line!

text: cued the finish at 268 m: about 19 pct reserve left, enough for a full sprint over the last ~80 s.
